title: Corrective fix for B-77482551: Shared Format Tests And Fixtures
description:
Blocked reason: Production code crash in ShoppingList.swift:rangeInText(for:) lines 85–90: content.index(lowerBound, offsetBy:) uses contentRange.lowerBound (an index in text) as a base index in content (a fresh String copy). Swift String indices are not interchangeable across distinct String instances. This crashes with \"String index is out of bounds\" whenever toggle() targets a line beyond the first few characters of a multi-line document.

Remaining work: Fix production code defect in ShoppingList.swift:rangeInText(for:) lines 85–90: replace content.index(lowerBound, offsetBy: offset, limitedBy: contentRange.upperBound) and content.index($0, offsetBy: length, ...) with calls that advance text indices from contentRange.lowerBound (requires passing text as a parameter or changing content from String to Substring). Once fixed, re-run swift test --filter ShoppingListParserTests.
acceptance_criteria: Implement the minimum fix required to unblock B-77482551.
Update tests/docs as needed for the corrective change.
Leave a handoff summary that states how the parent bead can be retried.

handoff_summary.completed: Fixed rangeInText(for:in:) in ShoppingList.swift: added text parameter, replaced content.index with text.index for result range arithmetic. Updated the toggle(itemAt:) call site. Build verified clean.
handoff_summary.remaining: Tester agent should run swift test --filter ShoppingListParserTests to confirm the fix passes arbitraryContentRemainsByteIdenticalAsideFromToggledLine and the full suite. Parent bead B-77482551 can be retried once tester confirms green.
handoff_summary.risks: Low. Change is confined to a private extension method and its single call site in ShoppingList.swift. No other files were modified.
handoff_summary.next_action: Tester agent runs swift test --filter ShoppingListParserTests to verify the crash is gone and all existing tests pass. After green, parent bead B-77482551 can be retried.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: Low — fix is confined to ShoppingList.swift private extension. No other bead files overlap.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Chose to add a `text: String` parameter to rangeInText(for:in:) rather than changing content to Substring, to minimise the diff and avoid touching all static helper call sites. The parameter name `text` shadows the outer struct property at the call site naturally.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: ShoppingListParserTests.swift already contains arbitraryContentRemainsByteIdenticalAsideFromToggledLine which toggles line 4 in a multi-line document — exactly the crash path. No new tests needed; tester should confirm this test now passes.

conflict_risks: Low — fix is confined to ShoppingList.swift private extension. No other bead files overlap.

execution_history.summary: Fixed production crash in ShoppingList.swift:rangeInText(for:). The method was using contentRange.lowerBound (a text-String index) as the base for content.index(...) where content is a distinct String copy — Swift String indices are not interchangeable across instances. Added `in text: String` parameter and changed index arithmetic to use text.index(...) throughout, keeping all indices in the same String. Build passes.
